description.p: An image viewer with a media-player style interface: the image fills the window, and all the controls are an on-screen display that hides by itself.

ul.li: Thumbnail strip, info panel and an icon bar, each shown only when wanted
Slideshow with transitions, a chosen interval and looping
Zoom, full screen, and everything reachable from the keyboard
PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, SVG, BMP, ICO and more
